header: Canonical department map: logical department -> member department codes (join user.departmentId -> departments.id, filter departments.code). I auto-grouped it from the 300-row department list by base name, then curated it: C&IT = {98500, 98540, 10153}; ELECTRICAL TECHNICAL LAB (ETL) = {10174,10181,10396}. Aliases are the short forms people type. To add or merge later, edit this file.

symbols.name: DEPARTMENTS
symbols.sig: const DEPARTMENTS: DeptGroup[] = [ { name: "A.G.M. MARKETING", codes: [10101], aliases: [] }, { name: "ACVS", codes: [10102, 10103], aliases: [] }, …

symbols.name: resolveDepartment
symbols.sig: export function resolveDepartment(term: string): DeptGroup | null
doc: I resolve a department term (name / alias) to its group, or null.

symbols.name: findDepartmentInText
symbols.sig: export function findDepartmentInText( query: string,): { group: DeptGroup; phrase: string } | null
doc: Find a department mentioned ANYWHERE in a free query (order-independent), matching a name or alias as whole words. The longest match wins. Returns the group and the matched (normalized) phrase, or null. I use it for the "name fragment + department" people search (e.g. "soumit c&it" / "c&it roy").
